comparison.objective: Release a camera plate from a cam clamp and place it safely; candidate releases a terminal locking tab and extracts the terminal.
comparison.physical_skill: Cam actuation, payload support and placement versus recessed blade insertion, wire deflection and coupled extraction.
comparison.success_condition: Camera/plate clear of mount, upright on pad and released without separation/drop; candidate terminal exits while housing and adjacent terminals remain intact. Candidate numeric damage limits are missing.
comparison.reason: The shared word “release” masks different mechanisms and tested manipulation abilities.
